row:
Hey friends, I'm May :) A vet and youtuber trying to figure out how to have a sustainable career in vet med, navigating my late 20s, sharing pet information I wished more people knew and documenting my journey along the way. I hope you find my videos useful, entertaining or even just comforting. So glad you're here. :) 

If you want to get in touch, please DM me via Instagram or leave a comment, I try my very best to reply to most things.

Vetty love, 
May xx
